g.text: On iteration 1 the harness has no evidence it can
undetermined. It will not decide for you.
enter opens it; the card beside is what it holds
↑↓ moves the cursor; the detail follows it
Add a --lang option choosing the language
of the greeting: en, fr or es, defaulting
to en. Keep the default output exactly as
one git worktree per run · seatbelt, network denied
a requirement is decided by evidence, never by an agent's word · every check
is run with and without the change, and one that reports the same thing both
times is taken out of the evidence · nothing reaches your tree until you ask
· ? lists the eight stops and every key
